I Worked Out Every Day for 35 Years. It Saved My Life

For three decades, I’ve built a career on a “no-nonsense” approach to personal training . My clients—many of whom are celebrities—often come in with outdated or flatly wrong ideas about fitness, and it’s my job to dispel these and help them get the type of body they want. The tools people need to get and stay fit aren’t sold in a bottle or at a store. They’re in your willingness to commit to a simple plan: Stay focused. Stay disciplined. Your life might just depend…
